content.title: Search the public website
content.description: An anonymous visitor opens the site search control from the homepage chrome, sees the data-collection notice and privacy-policy link, enters a term, and receives either suggestions or a results route without breaking the page or throwing console errors.
content.summary: Use the public site search entry point.
content.value: Shortens time to information when navigation browsing is slower than direct search.
criteria: The search control opens a search input and displays the data-collection notice with a privacy-policy link.
Search input accepts text and offers suggestions or a results route without causing a console error.
